text: {"score":4,"justification":"The summary is accurate and cautious, with specific numbers (25.7% vs 3.7%, risk-adjusted score 6.23, z 3.23, 33% low-complexity, 1 of 9 below billed, 0 of 17 data-reviewed) that all match the card. It balances the concern (high 99215 share in every band) against the documentation evidence (small sample, mostly supported), and flags the thin sample and possible templated notes. The leaning of inconclusive is reasonable. Weaknesses: the headline says 'every complexity level' while the card's by-complexity rows show shares above the all-provider rate but the 0-condition band is only 15.6%, so the wording is loose but defensible. The rationale suggests requesting records for specific zero-condition claims (C0088326, C0088332, C0088281, C0088486), but the formal next_steps do not name them and are generic. The cited example claims (C0088207, C0088212) are low-complexity 99215s with 1 condition, which fits the framing, but they are not the zero-condition claims the text recommends. Some claim-level uncited statements exist: C0088286 and C0088397 are described as low-complexity 99215s documented as high MDM, which matches the card (1 condition each). The 14% comparison figure is the all-provider rate for 99215 and is accurate.
